kp.lead: Relieve households, identify funding and organise the votes. Social progress and parliamentary support are separate tasks.
kp.entlastung.kurz: More social assistance, lower consumption taxes.
kp.entlastung.text: Social assistance at least +4, consumption taxes at most −1. Additional corporate taxes fund the extra cost up to their permitted limit. Existing higher assistance stays in place.
kp.umschichten.kurz: Reduce broad subsidies, strengthen social assistance.
kp.umschichten.text: Social assistance at least +4, broad subsidies at most −1. Corporate taxes cover the remaining gap where possible. Lower subsidies can raise energy and food costs and anger farmers.
kp.dienste.text: Social assistance at least +3, healthcare and pensions at least +2. Corporate taxes cover the extra cost up to their limit. Healthcare takes longer; any remainder increases the deficit.
kp.druck: Political low: {n} of 6 months. Below 25% approval the counter rises; at or above it, it gradually falls. A parliamentary majority alone does not prevent this loss of trust.
kp.finanzierung: Estimated deficit after passage: {vor} → {nach}% of GDP. Negative extra costs relieve the budget; revenue, interest and growth change later outcomes.
kp.reife: Effects build over about {n, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
kp.gruppenText: Points of group sentiment, not a direct polling bonus. Later prices, employment and public services determine lasting support.
kp.verhandlung: After introduction, choose vote agreements, confidence support or coalition deals. Costs and new faction pledges appear before each agreement. An at-risk coalition also needs talks or fulfilled pledges.
kp.partner: {partei}: {name} has {n} loyalty. Next review: {datum}. Below 20, {sitze} government seats are at risk; the package grants no automatic loyalty bonus.
kp.erschoepfung: Attention afterwards: {n}. Below 20 daily strain rises.
kp.dauer: New allocations apply from passage until a later budget change. Introduction alone has no relief effect; rejected packages leave existing allocations in place.
kp.beratung: This budget vote takes priority. Organise its majority; another amendment can only start afterwards.
kp.laufend: A budget bill is already under debate.
kp.erreicht: The package targets are already enacted.
kp.warten: After this rejection, {tage} days remain before another attempt.
kp.einbringenPreis: {pk} political capital and {auf} attention. No budget or approval change before the vote.
kp.beobachtung: Observed indices (0–100): lower poverty and living costs, higher real income are favourable. Changes also include inflation, other decisions and external crises; they are not an isolated package effect.
akte.wirtschaft.instrument.krisenratText: Fund social relief and secure majorities.
kg.beobachtung: Lower poverty and living costs, and higher real income, are favourable. These indices are not monetary amounts. Trends reflect all decisions and external influences, not just the latest relief.
kg.preiseSteigen: Prices keep rising even when a positive inflation rate falls. Relief can cushion lost purchasing power; wages, employment and price stability need separate decisions.
kg.preiseGrenze: The price index alone does not describe household conditions. Income, employment and supply matter too; state relief does not replace those tasks.
kg.m_mindestlohn.kurz: Protect purchasing power; weigh higher business costs.
kg.m_mindestlohn.text: Raise the statutory minimum wage nationwide. In the existing model, this strengthens lower incomes and reduces inequality. Effects begin only after passage and implementation.
kg.m_mindestlohn.preis: Higher wages also raise cost and price pressure. Especially high levels can increase informal work and youth unemployment; wage legislation alone does not end inflation.
kg.m_arbeitslosengeld.kurz: Limit poverty after job loss; fund social insurance.
kg.m_arbeitslosengeld.text: Expand the level and duration of unemployment benefits nationwide. This cushions lost income after losing a job; it does not itself create new jobs.
kg.m_arbeitslosengeld.preis: Social insurance funds face additional spending. Employees, young people and poor households benefit; business owners oppose higher social contributions.
kg.m_ausbildung.kurz: Support training; allow for long delays.
kg.m_ausbildung.text: Expand vocational training nationwide. Courses and apprenticeships improve prospects for young unemployed people and help businesses find skilled workers.
kg.m_ausbildung.preis: This is a long-term measure. The model delays the labour-market effect by nine months and the skills effect by twelve. Implementation and further feedback add time; acute hardship also needs prompt relief.
kg.umfang: Size of the next legislative step
kg.monate: About {n, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
kg.keinSoforteffekt: Introduction pays for the political work. Implementation starts only after passage; approval and social outcomes are not granted in advance.
kg.finanzierung: These annual model costs build up with the measure. This bill includes no automatic financing; check the budget. A new relief bill will not roll back a higher national target already passed.
kg.bedingt: Comparison under current conditions, including faction pledges that could be fulfilled. Other decisions and events may change conditions before the vote. New agreements arise only through your negotiations.
kg.keineReaktion: No immediate personal loyalty change in this preview. Later group and economic effects still apply.
kg.frist: {von}: “{text}” remains open. Introduction moves the deadline {vor} → {nach}.
kg.laufend: A bill on this measure is already pending. Secure its majority in parliament.
kg.umsetzung: The approved target {ziel} is still being implemented. Check progress before raising it further here.
kg.risiko: If passed under current conditions: {partei} · {name} has {n} loyalty. Below 20, the monthly review threatens the loss of {sitze} government seats.
kg.vorVotum: A coalition break threatens before the vote: {partei} · {name} has {n} loyalty. Review on {datum}; {sitze} seats at risk. Later passage cannot protect the coalition until then.
kg.regionalBeratung: The existing regional bill has target level {ziel}.
kg.landesBeratung: The existing national bill has target level {ziel}.
